faq.question: Can Saros 20 climb an 8.8 cm vertical step?
faq.answer: No. The cited claim is 4.5 cm plus 4.3 cm across a double-layer threshold with a gap greater than 12 cm and no more than 14 cm. It is not a single 8.8 cm wall or staircase rating.

faq.answer: The stronger case is a verified improvement at a troublesome doorway or in your mop-care routine. If the 10R already completes the route, the specifications alone do not establish enough benefit to justify replacing it.

faq.question: Does the refill-and-drain version work anywhere?
faq.answer: No. It needs a suitable power, water-supply and drainage arrangement and is available only in selected markets. Have the installation checked before ordering.

faq.question: What ongoing costs should I include?
faq.answer: Bags, filters, brushes, mop pads and approved cleaning solution, plus any installation or out-of-warranty service. Use prices for compatible local packs; WCB has not established a universal annual cost.
